score_null_policy: Score values may be null during migration or when a company has not yet completed a formal scoring review. Artha must render such values as Not scored and must not infer or calculate them.
rules: Artha must treat universe.json as read-only source data.
Artha must not maintain a second company universe.
Artha must not infer status from scores.
Artha must not infer action from status.
Artha must tolerate null optional values without crashing.
Artha must render null score values as Not scored and must not calculate substitute scores.
Artha must use id/ISIN as the stable company key, not ticker.
Artha must treat unknown future fields as forward-compatible and ignore them unless explicitly supported.
Artha must display last_reviewed so stale research can be identified.
